pretreatments.description: Physical grinding: The wood was debarked, cut, and grinded to achieve a relatively homogeneous size of less than 1 mm (20 mesh).

Physical milling (implied): The text mentions that milling was shown to improve enzymatic hydrolysis and is a typical process before most other pretreatments, but no specific mill conditions were detailed.
Chemical alkali pretreatment (NaOH treatment): A 5 g sample of milled pine wood was mixed with 95 g NaOH solution (8% w/w) and incubated for 10, 30, or 60 minutes at either 0 °C or 100 °C.
